AGENDA
SPECIAL MEETING OF NOVEMBER 4, 2024 OF
THE FINANCE ADVISORY COMMITTEE OF
THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make an inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 24 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The Finance Advisory Committee welcomes and encourages public participation at the Finance Advisory Committee meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to three (3) minutes or as specified by the Chairperson. Anyone wishing to address the Finance Advisory Committee is requested to fill out a speaker’s card available at the end of each row in the Chambers. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of Finance Advisory Committee minutes preparation.
The Finance Advisory Committee, at the direction of the Chairperson with concurrence of the Committee, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda. Note: Agenda topics may be continued to future Committee meetings.
CALL AND NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
To the Members of the Finance Advisory Committee of the City of Palos Verdes Estates:
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Chair has called a special meeting of the Finance Advisory Committee. The meeting will be called to order at 4:30 PM on Wednesday, December 20, 2023. The agenda for the special meeting with the items of business to be transacted or discussed is set forth below.
Pursuant to Government Code Section 54953(b), Committee Member Paul McNamara will be attending the Finance Advisory Committee meeting via teleconferencing from:
Location: 15th Floor
Street: 1723 Routh Street
Dallas, TX 75201
This teleconference location is accessible to the public and will be open to the public for attendance at this meeting.
